svg.title: Crown Mesa: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: The classic. A cliff-edged mesa holds the hill, with one graded ramp facing each base and a bots-only foot track up each side between the ramps. Edge hills split each flank into an inner and an outer lane, and two outcrops narrow every ramp's approach.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 16 × 16 map (8192 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 2v2v2
The classic. A cliff-edged mesa holds the hill, with one graded ramp facing each base and a bots-only
foot track up each side between the ramps. Edge hills split each flank into an inner and an outer lane,
and two outcrops narrow every ramp's approach.
Heights: plateau 260 · lowland 140 · edge hills 300 · the mesa (the hill) 340
Planet Verdance · a temperate grassland world
Ground: meadow grass on the plateau, darker damp grass in the lowland, grey granite on the mesa's
cliffs with scree at their feet, dirt roads.
Plants: oaktree_a, oaktree_b and oaktree_c in groves on the plateau, birchtree along the lowland,
ad0_fir on the edge hills, ferns in the outcrops' shade.
Features: rocks30_def boulders under the cliffs, armstone tombstones on the mesa top, a few fallen
Sky and weather: clear blue sky, light haze; wind 6 to 18; tidal 15.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
